en: Which sentence makes sense?
The dog barked at the cat.
The cat barked at the moon pie.
The table ate the dog.
Dogs bark, so “The dog barked at the cat” makes sense.
Which sentence makes sense?
I drink milk from a cup.
I drink a cup from milk.
The milk drinks me.
We drink milk from a cup.
Which sentence makes sense?
Fish swim in the sea.
Fish fly in the sky.
The sea swims in fish.
Fish live and swim in the sea.
Which sentence makes sense?
Birds build nests in trees.
Trees build birds in nests.
Nests eat birds.
Birds build their nests in trees.
Which sentence makes sense?
We wear coats when it is cold.
We wear coats in the bath.
Coats wear us when it is hot.
Coats keep us warm when it is cold.
Which sentence makes sense?
The sun rises in the morning.
The sun rises at midnight.
The morning rises in the sun.
The sun comes up in the morning.
Which sentence makes sense?
I brush my teeth before bed.
I brush my bed before teeth.
My teeth brush me.
We brush our teeth before bed.
Which sentence makes sense?
Ice cream melts in the sun.
Ice cream freezes in the sun.
The sun melts in ice cream.
Heat from the sun melts ice cream.
Which sentence makes sense?
A baker makes bread.
Bread makes a baker.
A baker eats the oven.
Bakers bake bread.
Which sentence makes sense?
Cows eat grass in the field.
Grass eats cows in the field.
Cows eat fields in the grass.
Cows graze on grass in fields.
Which sentence makes sense?
Rain falls from the clouds.
Clouds fall from the rain.
Rain falls up to the clouds.
Rain falls down from clouds.
Which sentence makes sense?
I read a book at bedtime.
A book reads me at bedtime.
I read a bed at booktime.
People read books, not the other way round.
Which sentence makes sense?
The baby is sleeping in the cot.
The cot is sleeping in the baby.
The baby is sleeping in the oven.
Babies sleep in cots.
Which sentence makes sense?
We cut paper with scissors.
We cut scissors with paper.
Paper cuts us with scissors.
Scissors are for cutting paper.
Which sentence makes sense?
Leaves fall from trees in autumn.
Trees fall from leaves in autumn.
Leaves grow on clouds in autumn.
In autumn, leaves fall from trees.

example.answer_en: The dog barked at the cat.
example.why_en: Dogs bark, so “The dog barked at the cat” makes sense.

en.title: Does it make sense?
en.teach: Read each sentence and picture it. Only one makes sense in real life.
